newsitem.title: USA: MCA restructures theme park unit.
newsitem.headline: MCA restructures theme park unit.

text.p: MCA Inc Tuesday said Ron Bension resigned as chairman and chief executive officer of the Universal Studios Recreation Group as part of a restructuring of the entertainment company's theme park division.
In a statement, MCA said a replacement for Bension will be named shortly. MCA is 80 percent owned by Seagram Co Ltd.

MCA also named Stephen Carley to the post of president and chief operating officer of Universal Studios Hollywood, where he will oversee the Universal City Cinemas and Universal CityWalk complex in California. Carley, a 12-year PepsiCo Inc executive, succeeds Bob Gault, recently appointed to head Universal Studios Japan. His appointment is effective immediately.

At Universal City Florida, Tom Williams, President and Chief Operating Officer, named Michael Corcoran to the post of executive vice president and chief financial officer; Dan Jensen, executive vice president for resort expansion; and Felix Mussenden, executive vice president and general manager of Universal Studios Florida.
Corcoran most recently served as interim chief financial officer of Seagram Beverage Co and will begin work immediately.

Effective January 1997, Jensen will serve as executive vice president for resort expansion and Mussenden as executive vice president and general manager of Universal Studios Florida. Both are longtime MCA/Universal employees.
